prompt: session:42 carries a 60-second TTL. The application then runs SET session:42 <new-json> with no expiry options. What TTL does the key have afterwards?
explanation: A plain SET replaces the value and clears any existing timeout — TTLs do not survive overwrites unless the command includes the KEEPTTL option. The refreshed value now has no expiry at all, a classic cause of sessions that never expire.

options.text: No TTL — a plain SET clears the previous timeout unless KEEPTTL is used
60 seconds — an existing TTL survives value overwrites
60 seconds, counted again from the moment of the overwrite
The SET is rejected until the current TTL runs out
